posts.subject: Aktuelle Lage, Spendenaufruf €
posts.bodyHtml:
Bitte haltet nachfolgende Informationen intern.


Dream hat momentan starke finanzielle Probleme. Da unser Sponsor (Nightlight) abgetreten ist, haben wir zurzeit keine feste Option die Server zu finanzieren.
Soweit es für euch realisierbar ist würde es uns weiterhelfen wenn sich ein paar Leute dafür bereit erklären die Community freiwillig finanziell zu unterstützen.
Jeder Betrag kann in der Hinsicht helfen. Wir werden weiterhin versuchen die Server&Community am laufen zu halten, zur Zeit, benötigen wir allerdings eine Stütze.


Falls jemand helfen kann/möchte oder irgendetwas beizufügen hat, kann er es in diesem Thema gerne preisgeben oder mich Privat kontaktieren.
Ich werde mich die Tage ebenfalls erkundigen welche Optionen offenstehen könnten, um diese Finanzierung standhalten zu können.

Hi ich bin in jedem Fall gewillt zu unterstützen!
Regelmäßigkeit und Höhe würden sich dann meiner momentanen finanziellen Situation anpassen...


Wäre echt Schade wenn das Projekt an Geld scheitern würde!
Auf lange Sicht muss eine Lösung her, wer Ideen hat immer raus damit [(:]

Würde selbstverständlich auch einen Teil finanzieren können, dennoch muss, wie wickedy bereits sagte, eine andere Herangehensweise gefunden werden.
Ein neuer Sponsor wäre dafür natürlich optimal, jedoch ist es beinahe unmöglich so einen zu finden.


"Unschöne" Lösungen wären dabei:

  • User auf die Situation aufmerksam machen (vielleicht findet sich ja so jemand, der einen Großteil der Serverkosten übernimmt?)
  • Werbung schalten (über MOTD bei Mapchange + Forum - keine Ahnung wie viel das einbringt)
  • Donatorstore härter pushen, mehr Items zum Donatorstore verschieben, stärker Werbung dafür machen (siehe Screen, der Text wird für jeden Spieler angezeigt)
  • [Bild]


Ich persönlich bin jedoch stark gegen jede Einschränkung von normalen Usern gegenüber Donatorn (aka Pay2Win).
Hat sonst jemand noch Ideen?

Morje,


Mein Vorschlag wurde schon an Sky ran getragen.


Trotzdem kann man Ihn nochmal Diskutieren:


Man sollte eine Spenden Übersicht einfügen, wie viel schon für den Monat gespendet wurde und was noch nötig ist.


So kann jeder sehen wie viel noch benötigt wird und vielleicht spendet dann der ein oder andere.
Es ist zwar ein Wunschdenken aber vielleicht klappt es ja.


Weiterhin nützt es uns Admins den User je nach Spendenstand zu movieren, dass sie spenden.


Es sind natürlich alle Admins dazu angehalten Map Vorschläge oder Server Verbesserungen zu unterbreiten, damit die Server aktuell gehalten werden und die User gebunden werden!


Gruß


Mario

Stimme Mario zu, eine Spendenübersicht ist eine gute Idee.
[Bild]


Es sollte nicht schwer zu implementieren sein und könnte wirklich so manchen User dazu anregen etwas zu spenden.


[dafuer*]

Wie wäre es mal mit einer Teambesprechung, in dem jeder der möchte eine Idee vorschlägt und um zu schauen wie man die Server fördern/"geschmackvoller" für die User zu machen. Da hier ja nicht so viel kommt.

Hmm, yeah. I think you did shoulderstand implement a repeating message server (one of those things where you see every 5 minutes or so in game) saying to the people:


"Enjoy our servers? Please! Donate to help keep the Dream community running!"


I personally dislike the VIP for a Certain period of time thing Because it just reminds me of Pay2Win.


Maybe, introduce a monthly donation system? So if a person desires to donate monthly, They can, and They get additional benefits for each month of continued support.


Boosted benefits (Increase the amount of credits given When people donate)


Maybe at ultimate donation package 50 euros gives you: forum stuff, 20,000 credits, a custom store item of your choice (so maybe They Can describe Their Own Desired trail or pet or nametag and you guys try the best to replicate it and implement it in -game).


A credit accumulator multiplier - I've been thinking about this for a while and I was thinking did all Final players on a server get a credit multiplier (so instead of 2 credits every minute, maybe increase it to 4 credits every minute so the multiplier will be x2). For example, if I was a guy who wanted to get a higher credit multiplier I can do the Following:
Get Final on a server (get x3 multiplier)
Donate 20 euros (get x2 multiplier)
Donate 50 euros (get x4 multiplier)
and if I did all of the above, I'd get x9 multiplier - so I'd get around 18 credits per minute.
Obviously, if this works, it will be crucial to implement more! Store items.


Maybe more privileges: such as immunity to kicks and bans from normal players. A special voice greetings When They join the server (Welcome back Doo Doo) - I think this shoulderstand be Implemented for finals as well Because I do not think Finals get very much (only a letter message on server doesnt really totally up for the amount of time you spent on dream).


Also, I think that Dream isn't really doing that much to make itself known to people. Making social media accounts for Dream (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram etc) could maybe encourage more people to join Dream and thus, increasing the probablity of how many times you're going to get donated.


Overall, you can resort to advertisements. Dream, I know for a fact that Dream Knife, is getting more popular. Therefore, getting sponsers from different gaming companies (Razer, SteelSeries, Pinguin, CSGO double etc) and displaying them on the screen enter enter (with the rules). would generate you more profit.


I wll be sure to list more options if I think of more ='D


Doo Doo

Is double post allowed on admin topics? I don't know but I had a really good point and I was scared I might forget it:


Doing feedback forms (surveys). People in Dream overall want a better time on the server and by creating a mini survey (Name, Feedback (what do you think that Dream can do to improve?). We obviously try to reply to these people and therefore, improving the server.


Also, there could be a Donator's list. For example:


Dream's Top Donators!
1. Doo Doo - Small loan of a million dollars.
2. Nachfrische - $200
3. aXaX - $150
4. Mario - $50.
5. Blackfire - $50


and so on, including every donator that maybe donated more than $10?

Thanks for the suggestions Doo Doo, I would like to adress some of the ideas you've mentioned.



Zitat von Doo Doo

"Enjoy our servers? Please! Donate to help keep the Dream community running!"

I like this idea and would like to see it implemented. Although Sky might say that it makes look us "greedy", I would disagree.



Zitat von Doo Doo

(...) a custom store item of your choice (so maybe They Can describe Their Own Desired trail or pet or nametag and you guys try the best to replicate it and implement it in -game).

This was already a thing when the donator store was first introduced. It was removed, because it's basically Sky doing everything and it's a lot of work to create a custom pet. Creating your own nametag was possible, although the tag wouldn't be only available to you but to every other donator as well.
( @Sky mir ist da eben ein Workaround eingefallen, könnte man da nicht für den Donator ein exklusives Nametag erstellen, es NICHT in den Store tun, aber es dem Donator über die Datenbank geben? Dann hätte er sein eigenes exklusives Nametag, welches man nicht im Store kaufen kann)



Zitat von Doo Doo

A credit accumulator multiplier - (...) and if I did all of the above, I'd get x9 multiplier - so I'd get around 18 credits per minute.

I don't know about that. If I were that donator, I would get 1k credits every hour and might just start giving away credits to everybody through !gift, since I already have everything and therefore it could create a credits inflation.





Zitat von Doo Doo

Maybe more privileges: such as immunity to kicks and bans from normal players.

Nope, paying money shouldn't make you immune to other people. What if someone who is constantly breaking rules decides to donate?



Zitat von Doo Doo

A special voice greetings When They join the server (Welcome back Doo Doo)

This is what is meant under the "Final VIP join sound". There used to be an join sound that would play if a Final VIP user joined. (). It was removed for reasons I don't know, maybe because it was buggy?
Although it might be a good idea to create an "Donator Join Sound".




Zitat von Doo Doo

Making social media accounts for Dream (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram etc) could maybe encourage more people to join Dream and thus, increasing the probablity of how many times you're going to get donated.

Eh, were are not that big 😄 We would need dedicated people to keep putting (high quality) content on those platforms and sometimes there is just not enough material.



Zitat von Doo Doo

Therefore, getting sponsers from different gaming companies (Razer, SteelSeries, Pinguin, CSGO double etc) and displaying them on the screen enter enter (with the rules). would generate you more profit.

Again, we are not so big 😄
I've mentioned advertisements on the MotD (message of the day, the thing you see when you join the server) in my post already, but I'm not sure how much money advertisements would bring in.
We could ask smaller websites for sponsoring us, I might message some of them, we'll see.



Zitat von Doo Doo


Doing feedback forms (surveys). People in Dream overall want a better time on the server and by creating a mini survey (Name, Feedback (what
do you think that Dream can do to improve?).

I already did that and to be honest, it was more or less a failure. A lot of the issues just couldn't be fixed. People saying that other people on the servers are stupid, breaking the rules, saying that some admins are bad etc.
Check the thread here: Offizielle Dream Umfrage (helft uns Dream zu verbessern!) + GEWINNSPIEL
And the results of that poll here: (some answers are censored, since I promised to publish some answers but make it completely anonymized. Some answers revealed their identites, some were just insults against individuals etc.




Zitat von Doo Doo

Also, there could be a Donator's list.

This was a thing when donations were first introduced. At least, kind of. If the person donating decided to publicly display their name and the amount donated, you could see them in a list. It was removed for reasons I don't know, maybe some people didn't want to show up?
@Sky - Top Donator Liste wäre echt was.

"This was already a thing when the donator store was first introduced. It was removed, because it's basically Sky doing everything and it's a lot of work to create a custom pet. Creating your own nametag was possible, although the tag wouldn't be only available to you but to every other donator as well."


Mmmm, but surely anybody rarely would donate 50 euros? And plus, can you not somehow spawn the name tag into sky's inventory, and then Sky distribute it to the specficied person? Nevertheless, having your own custom name tag into store for everyone would be better than what there already is.


"I don't know about that. If I were that donator, I would get 1k credits every hour and might just start giving away credits to everybody through !gift, since I already have everything and therefore it could create a credits inflation."


To be honest, not many people play for long, consecutive hours on a specific server anyways. Even if you give away credits to everyone, you'd have to think that the amount of people who donate to the amount of people who play the server reguarlarly, obviously doesn't balance out. I'd say for every donator who donated excessively and got the multiplier, there's around 30 regular players on Dream knife. Therefore, even if they did donate it, I don't believe that there would be any sort of massive credit inflation.


"This is what is meant under the "Final VIP join sound". There used to be an join sound that would play if a Final VIP user joined. (dream-community.de/sky/vipfinal.mp3). It was removed for reasons I don't know, maybe because it was buggy?
Although it might be a good idea to create an "Donator Join Sound"."


Well, maybe not a sound then, maybe a big message appearing on the top of someone's screen? If anything, there should be some way of making a Donator/Final VIP feel special when they enter/leave the server as a minimum to their efforts.


"Eh, were are not that big [Bild] We would need dedicated people to keep putting (high quality) content on those platforms and sometimes there is just not enough material."


Well, we can always get started :'D


"Again, we are not so big [Bild]
I've mentioned advertisements on the MotD (message of the day, the thing you see when you join the server) in my post already, but I'm not sure how much money advertisements would bring in.
We could ask smaller websites for sponsoring us, I might message some of them, we'll see."


I'd say that Dream is a pretty big community already, if you think about it, there's been around 50,000 individual players on the knife server alone. Maybe it isn't compared to maybe some other big CS:GO community servers, but I'd still think there'd be some (big) businesses interested in sponsering us if you convince them well.

@Marcello
Stimme da zu, wäre vielleicht wieder an der Zeit für eine Teambesprechung.
@Sky
Was meinst du?
